	### Foreign Policy ###
	focus = {
		id = GEN_1970_foreign_policy_review
		icon = global_community

		x = 129
		y = 0

		cost = 5

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INFLUENCE }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus GEN_1970_foreign_policy_review"
			if = { limit = { has_government = democratic }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_government = nationalist }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = democratic
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = fascism
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_government = nationalist }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = neutrality
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = communism
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = nationalist
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			add_political_power = 50
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GEN_1970_capital_defence_scheme
		icon = SAM

		x = 2
		y = 1
		relative_position_id = GEN_1970_air_force_reform

		cost = 10

		prerequisite = { focus = GEN_1970_air_force_reform }
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_AIRCRAFT }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus GEN_1970_capital_defence_scheme"
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
						free_building_slots = {
							building = anti_air_building
							size > 0
						}
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					add_building_construction = {
						type = anti_air_building
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.25 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				one_anti_air = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							has_dlc = "Gotterdammerung"
							NOT = { has_tech = air_defense }
						}
						NOT = { has_tech = air_defense_non_got }
					}
				}
